provenance.instrument: North Lebanon Township Zoning Ordinance (Chapter 27 Zoning, Ord. 6-4-84 of 6-4-1984, as amended), as published on eCode360
provenance.status_detail: eCode360 NO1608, Township of North Lebanon, Lebanon County (the code names the Lebanon County Planning Department, Recorder of Deeds and Conservation District). Chapter 27 Zoning was adopted 6-4-1984 and amended since, most recently in the zoning text by Ord. No. 5-2023 (5-15-2023, unlisted uses and variances). Every district part sets its uses and figures in text. The attachments are two figures, the dam breach inundation map and the pocket neighborhood design guidelines. New Laws lists nine items, none for Chapter 27
provenance.code_current_through_note: eCode360 Version Information: 'Includes legislation through 01-05-2026.' Uploaded 03-31-2026. New Laws lists nine 2026 items (Ord. No. 1-2026, Ord. No. 2-2026 and Res. No. 10-2026 to 16-2026), all for Appendices B, C and D, none for Chapter 27
checks: The zoning code has no accessory dwelling unit, in-law suite, accessory apartment or similar listing

A single-family detached dwelling is 'A detached (separate) building designed for or occupied exclusively by one family on an individual lot' (27-102). A dwelling unit has 'independent cooking and sleeping facilities for one family' (27-102)
An accessory building 'may not house a principal use nor may it stand alone on a lot as a principal building' (27-102)
No building may be erected or altered 'To accommodate or house a greater number of families' than the chapter allows (27-204.1B(2))

A use neither permitted nor prohibited goes to the Zoning Hearing Board as a special exception, but only if it is similar to the district's permitted uses and 'Is not permitted in any other zoning district' (27-204.1E(1)(a), (b)). Two-family dwellings and conversions to apartments are permitted in R-2, so this route is not shown for a second unit

In R-2 two-family detached (one unit over the other) and semidetached dwellings are permitted by right, at 4,500 sq ft of lot per unit with public water and sewer, and an existing building may be converted to apartments at 3,500 sq ft per unit with public sewer and water (27-602.2, 27-602.5, 27-603)

In any district more than one principal structure may stand on a lot if each meets the yard and other rules 'as though it were on an individual lot' and the subdivision regulations (27-1208). The single-family definition says 'on an individual lot', so whether a second house may share a lot is not settled
Every dwelling unit needs at least 700 sq ft of habitable floor area or 175 sq ft per person, whichever is greater (27-1211)
The lot and yard tables 'shall be provided for every dwelling unit' (27-304, 27-403, 27-503, 27-603)

Detached accessory buildings may not stand closer to the front than the house, except in A, IA and R-R when more than 75 ft from the road. They stand at least 5 ft from side and rear lines in R-2 and 10 ft in the other residential and commercial districts. An attached building meets the principal yards (27-1202)
One- and two-family dwellings need 2 parking spaces per dwelling unit, and a multi-family residence 3 per unit (27-1405E, F)
A nonconforming lot of record held in separate ownership may take 'a permitted principal structure and accessory structure(s)' (27-1602.1)
Where 25% or more of a lot is steeper than 15%, the residential lot minimum is 150% of the district figure (27-1224B)

In the floodway no new construction is allowed unless studies show no rise in flood levels and a DEP permit is obtained. In an AE zone without a floodway no new construction may stand within 100 ft of the top of bank without a DEP permit. Any use not specifically permitted by Part 11 is prohibited in an identified floodplain area (27-1117.1A, B(2), 27-1128)
The Zoning Hearing Board hears variances under MPC 910.2 (27-2001.1E, 27-2003). No section read bars a use variance. A special exception or variance lapses if not used within one year (27-2007)
provenance.notes: Zoning office: North Lebanon Township, Zoning Officer. Read in a browser on eCode360, one page at a time, on 2026-11-16, mostly in print view. Read: Parts 1 to 10, Part 12 through 27-1230, Parts 14, 16, 17 (site standards), 20, the floodplain areas and prohibited activities of Part 11 (27-1117, 27-1128), the opening and definitions of Part 24 (airport overlay, heights only) and the New Laws page. Not read: Parts 13, 15, 18, 19, 21 to 23, the rest of Parts 11 and 24, and 27-1231 and 27-1232 (CAO and apiaries). The code search was run for accessory dwelling, in-law, accessory apartment, family member, living quarters, ECHO, guest house, tenant house, caretaker, conversion, second dwelling, carriage house, granny, accessory suite, relative, servant, quarters, watchman, housekeeping unit and cottage. Its hits were the floodplain recreational vehicle definition, the habitable floor area, group care facility, family and family day-care definitions, the R-1 church-related homes for the elderly (27-502.8E) and non-zoning chapters. A family is at most five unrelated persons, and 'domestic servants employed on the premises may be housed on the premises without being counted' (27-102). Pocket neighborhood developments (R-2, conditional use, two acres) and age restricted developments (R-2, conditional use, 50 acres) are whole-tract developments. The unlisted-use route of 27-204.1E (Ord. No. 5-2023) is left out of the path because its test (b) fails for a use R-2 permits.

value.name: Two-family dwelling (R-2)
value.conditions: 'Two-family detached and semidetached dwellings' are a permitted use in R-2 (27-602.2). A two-family detached dwelling is 'A separate building on an individual lot with two dwelling units from ground to roof (one unit over the other)' (27-102). Two-family detached: 4,500 sq ft per unit, width 80 ft, front 30 ft, side 10 ft (20 ft together), rear 30 ft, building coverage 40% (27-603). Two parking spaces per dwelling unit (27-1405E). Every dwelling unit at least 700 sq ft of habitable floor area (27-1211)

requires.condition: The lot has public sewer. The table lists two-family rows only under 'Residential (public water and sewer)'

value.note: 9,000 sq ft is 4,500 sq ft for each of the two units. A stacked two-unit house, not a separate accessory unit. Whether an existing house may become a two-family detached dwelling by adding a unit above or below is for the zoning officer

value.name: Conversion of an existing building to apartments (R-2)
value.conditions: 'Conversions of existing buildings to apartments provided that the lot contains 3,500 square feet for each dwelling unit, public sewer and water and complies with parking regulations as found in Part 14' (27-602.5). Every dwelling unit at least 700 sq ft of habitable floor area (27-1211). Parking is 2 spaces per unit for one- and two-family dwellings and 3 per unit for a multi-family residence (27-1405E, F)
value.note: 7,000 sq ft is 3,500 sq ft for each of two units. The code does not say whether two units count as 'apartments' or which parking row applies

value.name: Second principal dwelling on the same lot (R-1)
value.conditions: 'In any district, more than one structure housing a permitted or permissible principal use may be erected on a single lot, provided that yard and other requirements of this chapter and the North Lebanon Township Land Subdivision Regulations shall be met for each structure as though it were on an individual lot' (27-1208). Each house then needs the R-1 lot area, width and yards of its own: 15,000 sq ft with public water and sewer, 20,000 with one, one acre with neither (27-503)
